source_claim: The accepted Brave Souls character roster and additional official Bleach routes were checked, but no new exact current campaign relation was established.

checked_routes.result: The first-party Brave Souls character roster was inspected. It includes a named roster and novel-collaboration entries, but did not explicitly identify a remaining current campaign member for a safe new relation.
The official Thousand-Year Blood War character directory timed out during page inspection; no claim about its unobserved contents is made.
Shueisha’s official BLEACH: No Breaths From Hell volume page provides a series synopsis but no exact current residual campaign identity that safely establishes a new relation.

notes: The broad Bleach campaign remains open. This records partial route progress only; the inaccessible anime page is not negative evidence, and no Research Unit is terminalized.
